summary: Frontend adds a Back-office “Technical Team Tools” panel with admin gating, delete/seed actions, confirmation dialog, and English feedback messaging. However, the diff summary does not provide evidence that the required new admin-only backend operations (reset providers and seed category-specific providers) were added/implemented in backend/main.mo, so REQ-108 and REQ-109 cannot be verified as implemented from the provided diff summary. Several additional unrelated frontend changes appear to have been made beyond the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an admin-only backend operation that deletes/removes all existing Service Provider accounts/data from canister state (at minimum: providerProfiles entries and provider role assignment), so browsing returns zero providers immediately after reset, and non-admins get an English authorization error.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo is shown only as type definitions in the truncated diff; there is no visible evidence of a new admin-only reset/delete-all-providers method, nor evidence it updates provider role assignments, nor evidence of the specified authorization error behavior.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add an admin-only backend operation to seed multiple category-specific service providers with realistic fields, stored non-null category, correct category filtering in getProviderResults, inclusion in All Providers (null category), and non-admin English authorization error.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not show any backend method that performs seeding, assigns categories, or enforces admin-only access with English authorization errors. The backend file excerpt is truncated before any such functions would be visible.

hallucinated_features.description: Broader client-side category filtering/routing changes (tracking selectedCategoryId, ProviderResultsPage updates, CategoriesPage changes, and conversion of categoryId to BusinessType in queries).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only asks for back-office controls to reset/seed provider datasets; it does not request changes to client browsing/filtering pages or routing behavior.

hallucinated_features.description: UI/theme and marketing content updates (new landing page sections, global styles/palette updates, Tailwind config changes, header/footer content changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-108/109/110; these are outside the scope of adding provider reset/seed tooling.

hallucinated_features.description: Provider detail engagement polling and additional provider card badges/UX updates.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; REQ-110 only concerns back-office dataset management controls.

hallucinated_features.description: Role onboarding change requiring providers to select exactly one category during onboarding.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested and potentially changes existing onboarding behavior beyond the dataset tooling requirements.
